import os,re,json
d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n')
G={}
for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
    k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
    rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
    if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
        G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
i1,o1=G['Demo pair 1 input'],G['Demo pair 1 output']
def f(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]
    y=max(i for i,r in enumerate(g) if any(x!=g[i][0] for x in r))
    # find bottom-most marker row(s); band rows between top marker row and bottom inclusive get outline-of-bbox fill
    ys=[i for i,r in enumerate(g) if any(x!=g[0][0] for x in r)]
    yc=min(i for i,r in enumerate(g) if any(x!=g[0][0] for x in r))
    yb=max(ys)
    mc=g[ys[0]][[j for j,x in enumerate(g[ys[0]]) if x!=g[0][0]][0]]
    xs=[j for j,x in enumerate(g[ys[0]]) if x!=g[0][0]]
    xmin,xmax=min(xs),max(xs)
    yk=g[0][0]
    H=len(g)
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for i in range(yc,yb+1):
        for j in range(xmin,xmax+1): out[i][j]=mc
    for j in range(0,xmin): pass
    # fill below bottom marker row
    for i in range(yb+1,H):
        for j in range(len(out[0])): out[i][j]=mc
    return out
# simpler direct: use actual colors per demo
def f2(g):
    base=g[0][0]
    ys=[i for i,r in enumerate(g) if any(x!=base for x in r)]
    mc=g[ys[0]][next(j for j,x in enumerate(g[ys[0]]) if x!=base)]
    xs=[j for j,x in enumerate(g[ys[0]]) if x!=base]
    yb=max(ys)
    xmin,xmax=min(xs),max(xs)
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for i in range(min(ys),yb+1):
        for j in range(xmin,xmax+1): out[i][j]=mc
    for i in range(yb+1,len(out)):
        for j in range(len(out[0])): out[i][j]=mc
    return out
print(f2(i1)==o1)
i2,o2=G['Demo pair 2 input'],G['Demo pair 2 output']
print(f2(i2)==o2)

# rule90 CA: neighbor = XOR of 2 diagonal neighbors
def ca_rule(g,n):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]
    for _ in range(n):
        H_=len(g); W_=len(g[0])
        ng=[[0]*W_ for _ in range(H_)]

                v=g[i-1][j-1] if i>0 and j>0 else 0
                wv=g[i-1][j+1] if i>0 and j<W_-1 else 0
                ng[i][j]=(v+wv)%2
        g=ng
    return g

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
# Gather all data: for each demo, markers and their outputs as boolean masks.
data=[]
for n_ in range(1,8):
    i_=G[f'Demo pair {n_} input']; o_=G[f'Demo pair {n_} output']
    H_,W_=len(i_),len(i_[0])
    bgv=i_[0][0]
    mk=set((r_,c_) for r_ in range(H_) for c_ in range(W_) if i_[r_][c_]!=bgv)
    out=[[o_[r_][c_] for c_ in range(W_)] for r_ in range(H_)]
    data.append(dict(id=n_, H=H_, W=W_, bg=bgv, mk=mk, out=out, vals=set(v for r_ in i_ for v in r_)))
for d_ in data:
    print(d_['id'], d_['H'],'x',d_['W'],'vals',sorted(d_['vals']))

import os,re,json,math
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
